    memory_hugepage_size,
    memory_prefault,
    memory_thp,
    boot_source_id,
    root_disk_object_id,
    boot_mode,
    image_ref,
    cloud_init_user_data,
    cloud_init_meta_data,
    cloud_init_network_config,
    network_id,
    networks,
    config
